_comment: Kit DESIGN_ID -> LDraw part file. 48 kit IDs have no .dat at that number. Structural parts are mapped to geometry-equivalent LDraw files (often an older mold number). Decorative parts with no usable geometry stay null.

106060.name: HUB, NO. 12 (SPIKE Prime Small Hub, mold rev.)

42798.name: BUSH FOR CROSS AXLE
42798.note: the FULL bush. BrickLink 3713 lists 6590 and 42798 as alternates. Do not confuse with 42136, the 1/2 bush.

42136.name: 1/2 BUSH
42136.note: BrickLink 4265c lists 32123 and 42136 as alternates; 4265c.dat redirects to 32123

_comment_45681_crossblocks: Expansion 45681. LEGO renumbered the cross-block family; LDraw still uses the original mold numbers. Verified against BrickLink 'Alternate Item No'.

49137.name: BEAM 3M D4.85 W. FORK
49137.note: LEGO Pick-a-Brick 49137 = BrickLink 87408 toggle joint double

88738.name: UPPER PART FOR TURNTABLE Z60, NO. 2
88738.note: straight-tooth mold variant; LDraw only ships the bevel-tooth 18938. Same footprint and pin holes, so it stands in for clearance and clutch.

44690.name: FLAT TILE 2X2, ROUND, NO. 1116
44690.note: print 1116 = 14769pr1116, a big cartoon EYE: blue iris, black pupil. Renders as a blank white disc here, so a render can never show the face -- trust the part number, not the picture. 2 of these plus 2 mold-revision 113420 = four large eyes in kit 45345

13360.name: FLAT TILE 1X1 - ROUND NO. 8
13360.note: also an EYE print: black iris with pupil, 1x1. Four in kit 45345. The small-creature eye; the 2x2 above is the big cartoon eye

113420.name: FLAT TILE 2X2, ROUND, NO. 1116 (mold rev.)
113420.note: same blue-iris eye print as 44690; different mold generation, interchangeable
